title: Flip a slice of bread in the pan with a spatula, then serve it onto the plate (Franka, operational-space control)
text: Flip the bread in the pan with the spatula, then lift it out on the spatula and set it down flat on the plate.
success: Success: at some point the bread was flipped in the pan (browned side up); at some point it came to rest flat on the plate within a few seconds of riding on the raised spatula blade; and it now lies flat on the plate (either side up), at rest.
